mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy, compressing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day forward returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in CPIAUCSL above 3.5% annually signals accelerating inflation, prompting monetary tightening that reduces equity valuations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when CPIAUCSL > 3.5% annually, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low unemployment (UNRATE < 5.0%) and high industrial production (INDPRO > 100.5) signals robust economic expansion, supporting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when both UNRATE < 5.0% and INDPRO > 100.5, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (UNRATE < 5.0% and GDPC1 growth rate < 1.0% year-over-year), high industrial production (INDPRO > 100.5) signals economic overheating and impending monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when INDPRO > 100.5 in the late-cycle regime (UNRATE < 5.0% and GDPC1 growth rate < 1.0%), or the Rank IC for INDPRO in that regime is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High employment growth (PAYEMS) indicates a strong labor market, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC between PAYEMS growth rate and 5-day forward returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when PAYEMS growth rate is positive.

mechanism_narrative: High housing starts (HOUST) signal robust consumer demand and economic expansion, supporting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC between HOUST and 60-day forward returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when HOUST is above 1500 (thousands of units).

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.5% signals labor market weakness, reducing consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when UNRATE > 5.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of strong consumer demand (RSAFS) and high housing starts (HOUST) signals robust economic activity, supporting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when both RSAFS and HOUST are above their 50th percentiles, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
